recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical split-screen composition featuring a warm-toned photograph of a man in western attire leaning against a vintage truck on the left, and a solid black field on the right. Large, distressed slab-serif typography bridges the two halves, utilizing a high-contrast color palette of white and earthy brown.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's body creates a vertical axis that aligns with the split-screen boundary.
The large white text overlaps both the photographic background and the black void.
Warm sepia tones in the photo harmonize with the brown accent text.
coreInvariants: Vertical split between a photographic scene and a solid black background.
Subject wearing a white cowboy hat as a visual highlight.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body male subject positioned slightly left of center, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white distressed text centered horizontally across the middle third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the white cowboy hat, moves down the subject's body to the large white text, then right to the secondary brown text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black vertical bar on the right side provides high-contrast space for text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Earthy Brown (secondary text and sepia photo tones).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photograph with high value contrast between the white hat/text and the black background.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme distressing and erosion on edges
Inconsistent stroke widths to mimic woodblock printing
Large, blocky serifs with rounded, worn corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: Glyphs feature 'bitten' edges and internal texture gaps
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast within the same stylistic family (distressed slab serif).

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the western woodblock feel with heavy slabs.
Matches the weathered, vintage aesthetic of the primary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a plaid shirt, jeans, and a white cowboy hat leaning against a vintage 1950s pickup truck. The setting is a dusty outdoor lot with a rustic building in the background. Apply a warm, sepia-toned film filter. Crop the image so the right 30% is a solid black vertical bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, distressed white slab-serif text across the center, overlapping the truck and the black bar. Add smaller, wide-tracked brown slab-serif text in the black area above and below the main white text.

verificationChecks: Is the right side a solid black bar?
Does the main text have a distressed, eroded texture?
Is the subject wearing a prominent white cowboy hat?
Is the color palette limited to sepia, black, white, and brown?

adjustableVariables: Level of distressing on the text
Width of the black vertical bar
Specific model of the vintage truck
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
Specific brand logos on the truck or building
Identifiable facial features of a celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text distressing looks organic, not procedural.
Check that the white hat remains the brightest point in the photo.
Verify the horizontal alignment of the text across the split.
Confirm the brown text color matches the warm tones in the photo.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a sepia-toned western portrait with a high-contrast black sidebar and bridge them with heavily distressed, oversized slab-serif typography.
